findings.summary: the block writer took a camera and an aspect and rebuilt the view and projection per draw, and a pass could hand it a matrix from one source beside a camera from another -- the shadow caster arm did; it now takes the three matrices its pass renders with, built once beside the product they factor, and a pass with no such factor leaves it null so a stage declaring it fails by name
the splat fragment's slot-guarded uniform push open-coded the guard and the cast that push_stage_uniform already performs, which every sprite, billboard and effect pass calls
the splat shader split re-inlined the packaged-literal extraction the same commit exports as pinnedSplatModuleWgsl, giving the pin's WGSL export two readers
the splat split's memo covered only the stock path, so a plugin scene re-read and re-split the packaged module twice per generation; the cache is keyed by module text instead of gated on the argument
SplatShaderSource.hasFragments recomputed a value its only reader already held as a parameter

the loadSplat intrinsic hand-rolled the allowed-property walk and the array-literal assert that validateObjectProperties and expectStaticArrayLiteral own, and unquoted a slot key with a regex where propertyName already returns it unquoted

SplatFragmentManifest was a two-optional-field union where four states were representable and two meaningful, paid for by an unreachable throw in its consumer; it is now a discriminated union like CompiledNodeMaterial

recordSplatFragments cleared and refilled an array that was either empty or already equal, and used length > 0 as "a list was recorded" -- so an empty list slipped the second-call guard; it is now undefined until recorded
an exported reachedSplatFragmentExports alias had no caller and asserted a coupling between two sites that did not exist
the linear-depth lowerer read and re-validated the pinned uniforms array three times through three methods, stating the same contract error in two spellings; one pass returns both halves

the linear-depth lowerer's two-column state table had a constant second column, and its restated material state asserted three properties while silently accepting any the pin might add; the declared set is now closed
createLinearDepthMaterial accepted a name option nothing could read, since the variant identity is the plane pair; it refuses instead
a private stringArray was copied from the line lowerer, and the createShaderMaterial-call accessor with it; both are LoweringContext helpers now
both folded-pinned-material families carried the same dedupe-compose-validate-register scaffolding around reachShaderProgram; one reachFoldedShaderProgram in shader-material.ts serves them
four emitters each wrote the same sixteen-cell narrowing tail after the pinned TRS composition; composeWorldBody emits it once, and the module's own "two emissions" comment was stale
the splat-mesh component assignment duplicated the mesh arm's emit rather than sharing it, interpolating an operator the preceding guard had already forced to "="
the Dawn splat upload composed the cloud's world matrix twice in one function over an unchanged record

the frame's view was built twice under adjacent guards (splat and billboard) and its projection took the perspective writer where the pin's getProjectionMatrix branches; both backends now build the frame's two factors once and every consumer reads them
the capture writer derived the width/height aspect a second time in the same header
the pinnedReverseDepthCompare extraction left the header's own doc block stacked above the new getter, so the header function became undocumented
the named-pinned-export registry (module map, has, names, load) is written twice, in pinned-tone-mapping.ts and pinned-splat-fragments.ts, and could be one generic pinnedExportRegistry
findings.blockedBy: The two reviewers disagree and the case for factoring is not yet made: at two instances with distinct refusal wording a generic registry costs about what it saves, and the reuse angle -- which read both files specifically to answer this -- concluded not to factor it yet. A third pinned-export family is what settles it.

findings.summary: the SDL splat pass composes the cloud's world matrix once in upload_splat_pass and again in record_splat_pass, two functions a frame apart
findings.blockedBy: Unlike the Dawn pair these are two functions called from two points in the frame, so removing the second call means caching the matrix on the pass record -- which is state whose invalidation nothing measures, for roughly 50ns a frame. The efficiency angle called it a tidiness finding rather than a performance one and the simplification angle said to leave it.

findings.summary: shader_stage_block_floats allocates a std::vector<float> per stage block per draw
findings.blockedBy: Pre-existing and untouched by this branch, which changes what each call computes rather than how often it runs; removing it needs a caller-owned scratch buffer threaded through both backends and the capture writer, which is its own change with its own neutrality proof.
